props.name: value
props.description: The whole output so far. When a new value extends the old one only the new part is parsed; any other change starts over. Leave it out and use the ref’s `append` for streaming instead.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: Lines kept before the oldest scroll away.

props.name: follow
props.description: Keep the newest line in view while the reader is at the bottom.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways.

props.name: announce
props.description: Announce new output to screen readers. Off by default: a redrawn progress bar would be read on every frame.

props.name: palette
props.description: Override palette entries 0–15 with any CSS colour.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Set the height here.
